item.title: Refactor order status to OrderStatus enum
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate order status from String to a typed enum. Add src/status.rs with public OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } deriving Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement as_str(self) -> &'static str with lowercase names; Display with identical output; FromStr with type Err = ParseStatusError, a public Error type whose message names rejected input. Implement can_transition_to with exactly pending->paid/cancelled and paid->shipped/cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root, and use enum everywhere so status string literals occur only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior exactly (errors, report output and ordering, parsing). Ensure cargo test passes and commit the work. Keep compatibility of error/report formatting and sorting as currently observable; inspect existing code/tests before changes.
